listing.aiSummary: Adds three procedural star systems near the core worlds to speed up colonization and provide farming locations.

description:
Suitable Star Systems 2.4.4d

Compatibility:
Only works on new saves
Not safe to remove from an ongoing campaign
Not save compatible for versions below 2.4.0a

Integrations:
LunaLib - Has native support for mod settings

A mod that I privately use for my Starsector campaigns.
The mod adds three star systems to different constellations near the core worlds.
The colonizable star system is overpowered and are meant to speed up the colony phase.
The other star systems are places you can farm alpha cores and [SUPER REDACTED] weapons.

The location and the star system names are procedural so you still need to explore.
The first system contains the planets to colonize as well as all unique entities.
The second system contains a planet that spawns remnant fleets.
The third system contains a planet that spawns omega fleets.

Previews
Click the image to enlarge

Secrets
For the omega system, you need the planet killer and then use it on the planet to make omega fleets start spawning.
(The mini-quest can be overridden in the settings.json file found in the modname/data/config. So you don't need the planet killer and the omega fleets will immediately spawn. Can be enabled and disabled any time)

Settings
- If you have lunalib, settings options are in the mod settings
- If you don't have lunalib, settings options are in the settings.json file in "thismodname/data/config/..."

If you need help or want to send feedback, you can make a post on this thread.
If you want to support me, you can do so through my Patreon page.

Credits
Wispborne - for the starsector intellij mod template and the github action script.
starsector community - for many resources in regard to modding and spriting.
Alex and Co - for making a great game and community.

discordPostHtml:
A mod for starsector that adds star systems to different constellations near the core worlds, star systems are overpowered and is meant to speed up colony phase or midgame/endgame.

Requirements:

  • None

Compatibility:

  • Should be compatible with most mods
  • Not save compatible for versions below 2.4.0a
  • Not safe to remove from an ongoing campaign

Integrations:

  • Lunalib - Native support for mod settings

For more info check out the forum thread link.
For mod changes check out the changelog link.

Download: https://github.com/AudaxLudos/suitable-star-systems/releases/latest/download/SuitableStarSystems.zip
Changelog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AudaxLudos/suitable-star-systems/main/CHANGELOG.txt
Old Versions: https://github.com/AudaxLudos/suitable-star-systems/releases
Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=25418.0
aiDescription: Adds three star systems to different constellations near the core worlds. One system is overpowered to speed up the colony phase, while the others allow farming of alpha cores and special weapons. The locations and names are procedural, requiring exploration to find them.
